cases.name: alias-acquirer-collision
cases.given: ACQ-B provisioning DE32=1 already maps ACQ-A
cases.then: reject collision; preserve ACQ-A; no activation/dispatch

cases.name: alias-merchant-collision
cases.given: MERCHANT-A2 in ACQ-A requests MERCH0000000001
cases.then: reject inverse collision, no overwrite

cases.name: alias-terminal-collision
cases.given: TERMINAL-A2 same merchant requests TERM0001
cases.then: reject inverse collision

cases.name: long-reference
cases.given: acq/mid/term/pay each 128 ASCII characters; registered durable aliases
cases.when: structural pack/unpack <=999, then separately evaluate NEW exchange admission <=826
cases.then: Preserve full registered refs without truncation. <=826 may pass admission after all current new-work checks; 827–999 structurally packable but ADMISSION_RESPONSE_CAPACITY before claim/send. 129-byte individual ref invalid. Linked retry reads original and never encodes/sends new instruction.

cases.name: stan-tenants
cases.given: AUTH-A and AUTH-B in distinct contexts use STAN 000001/RRN 000000000001
cases.then: separate identities, OP-A cannot read B; never merge

cases.name: stan-wrap
cases.given: ACQ-A counter 999999 then 000000 with different aid/pay
cases.then: match full aid/cid/gen not latest STAN; RRN collision does not merge

cases.name: restart-replay
cases.given: V01 claimed 2026-11-18T12:00:00Z; service restarted
cases.then: same AUTH-001 generation 1; latest evidence; zero new dispatch

cases.name: expiry-generation
cases.given: same retained key unlinked at 2026-11-19T12:00:00Z
cases.then: generation 2 new aid allowed, original not cancelled

cases.name: linked-expiry
cases.then: original generation 1 replay no dispatch; foreign/unknown prior rejects before local key lookup

cases.name: amount-conflict
cases.given: V01 original USD 10.00
cases.then: conflict, original unchanged no dispatch

cases.name: currency-conflict
cases.given: V01 original USD 10.00
cases.then: non-USD validation rejection no dispatch; original unchanged

cases.name: fixture-conflict
cases.given: V01 fixture SIM-APP-001
cases.then: conflict no dispatch; registry cannot reselect existing result

cases.name: history-outage-before-send
cases.given: history/projector unavailable; authoritative journal+critical outbox healthy with 8 reserved slots
cases.when: valid new V01 and on-time V02
cases.then: atomic business/outbox claim and possible-send precede ONE invocation; commit verified outcome+outbox; HTTP200 APPROVED even though history absent, observation PARTIAL, no financial retry

cases.name: postdispatch-trace-outage
cases.given: V01 sent, V02 durable business evidence; trace append down
cases.then: APPROVED retained; critical event already atomic in business transaction, history lag PARTIAL; asynchronous replay projects only, no retry/rollback

cases.name: journal-outage
cases.given: V01 possibly sent; V02 in memory; atomic business evidence+critical outbox transaction fails
cases.then: 503 NOT_CONFIRMED; no trace-only authority; no redispatch; issuer diagnostic separate

cases.name: issuer-truth-only
cases.given: issuer approved but no processor receipt by 12:00:02Z
cases.when: read normal detail and separately permitted diagnostics
cases.then: processor UNKNOWN, diagnostics may show issuer approval; never promote table read

cases.name: events-reorder
cases.given: terminal event E2 arrives before start E1, distinct clocks
cases.then: two logical events, no false duration; exact E2 duplicate no-op; changed E2 quarantined

cases.name: retention-reconnect
cases.given: trace collected 2026-11-18T12:00:00Z expires 2026-11-25T12:00:00Z; business link retained
cases.when: poll expired cursor then linked retry
cases.then: 410 authorized resync, trace unavailable gap; original retained; no second dispatch

cases.name: revocation
cases.given: OP-A read then registry revoked at 12:00:03Z
cases.then: deny, clear view; old cursor not authority; diagnostics requires independent permission

cases.name: replay-bound
cases.given: 100 transactions/1000 retained events, 100 per page, active authorized reader
cases.then: Proposed reconnect-to-ALREADY-PROJECTED1000-event watermark <=10s; old backlog age visible, source backlog drain separately measured. Proposed committed-to-project p95<=2s/p99<=5s and project-to-display p95<=2s/p99<=5s only under healthy measured load; sampling/drop coverage separate. No unconditional guarantee from Streams/CloudWatch.

cases.name: future-hook
cases.given: future capability implemented but missing manifest or common schema producer
cases.then: activation rejected; auxiliary manifests need no ISO mapping, no B/C implementation commissioned

cases.name: sensitive-trace
cases.given: input contains PAN/DE2, DE55 or token in malformed data
cases.then: reject unsupported inputs, only safe metadata persisted; no raw bytes/log/body or executable UI text

cases.name: claim-outbox-crash-before-send
cases.given: 2026-11-18T12:00:00Z atomic CLAIMED_NOT_SENT+critical outbox committed; crash before CAS
cases.then: HTTP503 null NOT_DISPATCHED RESERVED_UNSENT; original linked ATT-002; no resumed send. This is crash state, NOT a history-backend failure gate.

cases.name: claim-restart
cases.given: durable CLAIMED_NOT_SENT with atomic critical event; crash before possible-send commit
cases.then: same 503 null NOT_DISPATCHED; no dispatch; positive unsent proof is durable gate state

cases.name: claim-crash-before-CAS
cases.given: CLAIMED_NOT_SENT+critical event atomically committed, history may be down
cases.when: crash before atomic POSSIBLE_SEND+critical event then restart
cases.then: 503 null NOT_DISPATCHED RESERVED_UNSENT; no invocation on restart; async history availability never prerequisite

cases.name: CAS-success-crash-before-send
cases.given: POSSIBLE_SEND+critical event atomically committed12:00:00Z; crash before actual invocation
cases.then: 202 NOT_CONFIRMED PENDING on retry; cannot claim NOT_DISPATCHED; no resumed invocation

cases.name: send-crash-before-evidence
cases.given: POSSIBLE_SEND invocation occurred then crash
cases.then: 202 NOT_CONFIRMED PENDING, no redispatch; deadline response UNKNOWN

cases.name: confirmed-before-async-project
cases.given: V02 business evidence+critical event committed atomically; projector has not run before crash
cases.then: 200 REPLAY APPROVED from journal, PARTIAL projected history, same original IDs, no send; pending event recovered from outbox

cases.name: unsent-window-boundary
cases.given: AUTH-001 CLAIMED_NOT_SENT firstReceipt 2026-11-18T12:00:00Z
cases.then: new generation 2 allowed after normal checks, explicit new-payment warning; old preserved. Prior AUTH-001 still 503 null NOT_DISPATCHED generation 1

cases.name: CAS-write-uncertain
cases.given: CAS transport fails and journal cannot be read
cases.then: 503 null UNAVAILABLE serverFreshness UNKNOWN; no invocation; subsequent authoritative read determines state, never guess unsent

cases.name: registry-route-scenario-change
cases.given: original SIM-APP-001 DOMESTIC/PASS pinned; registry now INTERNATIONAL/decline; default risk changed
cases.then: compare persisted PASS and exact fixture ID; stored result/original route unchanged, no decision rerun

cases.name: fixture-retired
cases.given: original fixture removed/disabled, current caller/context active
cases.then: stored result replays; fixture retirement does not reject replay; NEW unlinked generation rejects inactive fixture

cases.name: context-revoked-replay
cases.given: same stored APPROVED record but current context revoked
cases.then: 403 no outcome disclosure even if exact stored key; original unchanged

cases.name: all-store-outage
cases.given: browser holds APPROVED asOf 12:00:01Z; server cannot read journal/traces at 12:00:05Z
cases.then: 503 UNAVAILABLE null outcome/UNKNOWN observation and serverFreshness; browser retains marked stale snapshot, connection not inferred from server freshness

cases.name: late-handler-order
cases.given: signed issuer evidence received at 12:00:05Z after timeout, no prior processor evidence record
cases.when: P5 authenticate/load/bind then atomic evidence+business version+critical event commit then response; projection/telemetry later
cases.then: UNKNOWN becomes APPROVED only after atomic commit; required journal/outbox failure remains NOT_CONFIRMED; history/backend outage alone does not block or revert confirmation
